subject: reasoning
question:
Refer to the following number and symbol series and answer the question that follows. Counting to be done from left to right only.

(Left) © & 9 4 5 # 6 2 $ © 8 2 £ @ & # 5 £ % & # 1 (Right)

How many such symbols are there each of which is immediately preceded by a number and also immediately followed by a symbol?
solution:
Given: 

(Left) © & 9 4 5 # 6 2 $ © 8 2 £ @ & # 5 £ % & # 1 (Right)

Now, 

Symbols, which are immediately preceded by a number and also immediately followed by a number.

So, Needed pattern is: Number - Symbol - Number.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34e0a56d7ccc70c63426f189b17334147690c3f5807bbe3781b822beb8b1c568.png] 

There are 3 symbols which is immediately preceded by a number and also immediately followed by another symbol.

Hence, the correct answer is* 'Option 2'.*
